node.title: The degree-2048 plane endpoint is an exact symmetric 218_15 configuration
node.closure: equality propagation, leave-graph Gram ledger, and quotient-fiber defect concentration
node.statement: In the e=2048 branch of the plane-218 pure-power router, the 218 selected points and 218 full lines form a symmetric 218_15 configuration with distinct directions in mu_1024. Point and line leaves are 7-regular with 763 edges. The incidence matrix M satisfies MM^T=14I+J-L_P and M^TM=14I+J-L_B, is nonsingular over the reals, and the leaves are cospectral. Aggregate fiber defect is at most 72, so at least 146 direction fibers are saturated; some point lies on at least 11 saturated lines and some point has incident defect at most four, contributing at least 30716 full coordinates to its residual core. No official-field exclusion or quotient payment is claimed.
